title: How Europe's heatwave is proving Americans right about air conditioning
description: Europeans are now buying air conditioning units in unprecedented numbers. This trend is driven by record heatwaves and rising health concerns across the continent. This cultural shift reflects a growing understanding of cooling as an essential need.
